dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-dorsal and lateral regions feature prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures consisting of high-intensity (light-colored) perimeters surrounding darker centers. The perimeters exhibit irregular, jagged geometries with high-frequency pixel variations at the outer edge transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of solid, low-intensity (dark) pixel clusters is visible on the head and muzzle. Conversely, a high-intensity (bright) cluster of pixels forms a localized, jagged linear feature along the upper dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the mid-lateral section form an obtuse triangle, with the vertex of the obtuse angle oriented toward the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinct, high-intensity white vertical band-like structure is visible at the junction of the head and the main torso.
